basics.name: Jordan Avery
basics.headline: Data Engineering Team Lead · Lakehouse, Streaming & Analytics Engineering

summary: Data engineering team lead who builds and runs data platforms end to end: a Databricks lakehouse, batch and streaming pipelines in Python, Spark and SQL, and dbt modeling with tests and data contracts. 10 years in data across logistics, retail and healthcare.

Currently leads a team of 4 data engineers at Harborlight Logistics, a freight-visibility SaaS, where the new lakehouse cut monthly warehouse cost by about 35%. Looking for a senior data platform role.

experience.company_blurb: B2B SaaS for freight visibility used by shippers and carriers
bullets: Lead a team of 4 data engineers that owns the data platform: carrier GPS/telematics and shipment-event ingestion, the lakehouse, dbt models and internal analytics
Built the lakehouse on Databricks and Delta Lake, replacing Redshift and migrating 30 pipelines, which cut monthly warehouse cost by about 35%
Built a near-real-time ETA events pipeline with Kinesis and Spark Structured Streaming, reducing latency from about 1 hour (batch) to under 5 minutes
Introduced dbt with tests and set up data contracts with the backend team so schema changes stop breaking pipelines
Work closely with data science, product and backend teams; write design docs and take part in the on-call rotation
Interviewed and hired 2 engineers; mentor 2 junior engineers

experience.title: Data Engineer
bullets: Built and maintained 40+ Airflow DAGs ingesting POS and e-commerce data into Amazon Redshift
Processed clickstream data with Apache Spark on Amazon EMR for about a year
Designed a dimensional data model for sales reporting, used by 120 analysts across 3 countries
Migrated legacy SSIS jobs to Python, reducing nightly load time from 5 hours to 2 hours
Optimized Redshift distribution and sort keys, cutting dashboard query times by 60%
Contributed to data quality checks with Great Expectations

experience.title: BI Developer
bullets: Developed Tableau dashboards for hospital operations teams and monthly reporting for 14 client hospitals
Wrote complex SQL for claims analysis in SQL Server
